title: When the Deadline Burns
author: Silas Sterling
blurb: Juniper Ravensworth, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
